body.x: ActivMotion launches a Bluetooth headset, extra-auricular, which offers full transparency and constant connection with the environment, for office work. Natural sound and comfort allow the user to forget completely the headset. With its minimalist, light and almost invisible design, communication becomes far less intrusive.

Freeing the ears reduces stress and noise fatigue by comparison with standard headphones. Teamwork can stay efficient and smooth during the full work day. The battery lifetime is much monger than a day's work, and, thanks to the magnetic connector, the battery can be charged during communication.
As working from home becomes more common, wearing the CRURA is as nice in home office as in company office. When switching the video on, quasi-invisible CRURA lets people face look natural again.

With the unique technology Xtrasound, the sound does not go directly in the ear canal and offers a truly unforgettable audio experience. Comfort and audio quality compare favorably to existing technologies like bone conduction or in-ear earphones.

ActivMotion creates communication wearable's, for easy and light communication in various environments. Our products free the ears and hands of the users. Our aim is to make connected life lighter and less intrusive.
